title: GATE 2027 important dates

dates.title: Regular registration closed
dates.note: Fee per paper: ₹1000 (female, SC, ST, PwD) or ₹2000 (others)

dates.title: Extended registration closes (with late fee)
dates.note: Fee per paper: ₹1500 (female, SC, ST, PwD) or ₹2500 (others)

dates.title: Last date to change category, paper or exam city, add a paper, or correct personal details
dates.note: An extra fee may apply for each change

dates.title: Exam city notification
dates.note: You are told which city you are allotted

dates.title: Admit card download
dates.note: Date to be announced. Take a colour printout and your original photo ID

dates.title: Examination
dates.note: 6, 7, 13, 14, 20 and 21 Feb 2027. The date and session for your paper are on your admit card

dates.title: Answer keys and contest window
dates.note: Dates are announced after the exam

dates.title: Results announced
dates.note: Score cards can be downloaded after this

dates.title: Paid score card download ends
dates.note: ₹500 per paper after the free period. The score is valid for 3 years

fees.note: Fees are per paper. Two papers cost twice as much. Bank charges are extra.

pattern: General Aptitude: 10 questions, 15 marks (5 of 1 mark, 5 of 2 marks)
Subject: 55 questions, 85 marks, including 13 marks of Engineering Mathematics
MCQ, MSQ and NAT questions. No partial marks
Wrong MCQ: ⅓ off (1-mark) or ⅔ off (2-mark). No negative marks for MSQ or NAT
exam_day: Sessions: forenoon 9:30 AM to 12:30 PM, afternoon 2:30 PM to 5:30 PM
You can take your seat 40 minutes before the start and log in 20 minutes before. No login is allowed after 15 minutes from the start
Bring a printed admit card (A4, preferably colour) and the original photo ID you used when applying
Not allowed: mobile phones (even switched off), watches, calculators, wallets, papers, Bluetooth or other electronic devices
A virtual scientific calculator is on the screen, and a scribble pad is provided for rough work
links_note: Past papers (2007 to 2026) can be downloaded from the Downloads tab of the official website.
